image_description: A close-up view of a vertical traffic light assembly mounted on a dark metal pole. The primary signal head shows a red light at the top and a green light at the bottom, both illuminated. The housing is black with distinct visors over each lens. To the right, a portion of a second signal head is visible but unlit/dark. The background features a multi-story building with windows and some green foliage at the bottom.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The internal reflector pattern of the green light appears slightly irregular and 'noisy' rather than a perfect geometric grid, which is common in AI generations but could also be due to image compression or low resolution.
The secondary signal head on the right fades into darkness/shadow without clear definition of lenses or housing edges, appearing somewhat 'melted' or undefined compared to the crisp main unit.
Slight warping in the straight lines of the background building windows, though this may be attributable to camera lens distortion rather than AI generation.
